import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Define a nice color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# Plot 1: Total Sales by Product
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, val) in enumerate(zip(bars1, product_sales.values)):
    ax1.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group and Size
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_size_sales = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Order age groups logically
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_size_sales = age_size_sales.reindex([ag for ag in age_order if ag in age_size_sales.index])
age_size_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff', '#99ff99'], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sales by Age Group and Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Size', loc='upper right')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 3: Payment Method Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_counts = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
explode = [0.02] * len(payment_counts)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(payment_counts)],
                                    explode=explode, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sales Distribution by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# Plot 4: Daily Sales Trend with Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['is_takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map({1: 'Takeaway', 0: 'Dine-in'})
daily_sales = df.groupby([df['date'].dt.date, 'is_takeaway_label'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
daily_sales_rolling = daily_sales.rolling(window=7, min_periods=1).mean()

ax4.plot(daily_sales_rolling.index, daily_sales_rolling.get('Takeaway', [0]*len(daily_sales_rolling)), 
         label='Takeaway', color='#ff6b6b', linewidth=2)
ax4.plot(daily_sales_rolling.index, daily_sales_rolling.get('Dine-in', [0]*len(daily_sales_rolling)), 
         label='Dine-in', color='#4ecdc4', linewidth=2)
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales_rolling.index, daily_sales_rolling.get('Takeaway', [0]*len(daily_sales_rolling)), 
                  alpha=0.3, color='#ff6b6b')
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales_rolling.index, daily_sales_rolling.get('Dine-in', [0]*len(daily_sales_rolling)), 
                  alpha=0.3, color='#4ecdc4')
ax4.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sales ($ - 7-day Moving Avg)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Daily Sales Trend: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(loc='upper right')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
